sections.heading: What Is RCS Business Messaging and How Does It Work

blocks.html: RCS messaging — short for Rich Communication Services, the global standard maintained by the GSMA — upgrades a plain text thread into a two-way, app-like conversation. It runs inside the phone's default messaging app, so customers never need to download anything new to see it.

items.title: Native to the messaging app:
items.desc: no separate download — RCS messaging opens inside the phone's default SMS/messages app.

items.title: Verified sender branding:
items.desc: customers see your business name, logo and brand colour instead of an unfamiliar number.

items.title: Rich cards and carousels:
items.desc: product photos, videos and swipeable catalogues appear directly inside the thread.

items.title: Suggested replies and quick actions:
items.desc: customers respond with a tap instead of typing out a message.

sections.heading: DLT & TRAI Compliance for RCS Sender IDs

blocks.html: Google's RCS agent verification confirms your brand identity, but it doesn't replace India's existing SMS compliance framework — most RCS campaigns still fall back to SMS for unsupported devices, and that fallback layer stays governed by TRAI's Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) rules.

items.title: DLT-registered sender IDs:
items.desc: every business identity and template stays registered and traceable, in line with TRAI's framework.

items.title: Template-level compliance:
items.desc: promotional and transactional content is checked against DLT categories before it goes out.

items.title: Two layers, not one:
items.desc: Google's RCS verification and DLT registration run alongside each other, covering both the rich and fallback layers.

items.title: Audit-ready records:
items.desc: delivery and consent logs are kept for every registered sender ID.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About RCS Business Messaging in India

items.q: How much does RCS messaging cost for businesses in India?
items.a: Pricing typically combines a platform or API subscription with a per-message fee for rich cards and carousels, plus SMS fallback charged separately when a device doesn't support RCS. Ojiva AI shares an actual INR rate card once your expected volume and template mix are known — book a free demo and we'll walk through it.

items.q: How do I register my business for RCS Business Messaging in India?
items.a: Registration runs through Google's Business Messages console, where you submit business details and brand assets for verification. A messaging partner like Ojiva AI can manage this agent registration alongside your DLT sender ID setup, so you're not handling two separate processes.

items.q: Do I need DLT registration if I'm sending RCS messages?
items.a: Yes, if your campaigns include an SMS fallback — which most do, since RCS doesn't yet reach every device. Keeping SMS sender IDs and templates DLT-registered ensures fallback messages still deliver compliantly when RCS isn't available.

items.q: How long does RCS agent verification with Google typically take?
items.a: It depends on how quickly business details and brand assets are submitted and reviewed, since Google verifies the business identity before issuing the checkmark badge. Working with a partner who submits everything correctly the first time avoids most of the common delays.

items.q: Can I send RCS messages to iPhone users?
items.a: Apple has added RCS support to its Messages app, so iPhone users on supporting carriers can now receive RCS content, though the interactive feature set can vary by device and OS version. Campaigns should still include an SMS fallback to cover devices and networks that don't support RCS yet.

items.q: Can I integrate RCS messaging with my existing CRM or helpdesk?
items.a: Yes — a single messaging API typically sends delivery, read and reply events as webhooks, which your CRM or helpdesk can consume like any other channel. That keeps RCS conversations logged alongside your existing customer records instead of sitting in a separate tool.

items.q: What's the difference between RCS messaging and the WhatsApp Business API?
items.a: RCS runs natively inside a phone's default messaging app with no download required, while WhatsApp needs the WhatsApp app installed and an opted-in contact. Many Indian businesses run both — RCS for native, app-free reach and WhatsApp for its larger existing user base.

items.q: What should I check before choosing an RCS messaging vendor in India?
items.a: Ask for a real INR rate card, confirm they manage both Google's agent verification and DLT sender registration, and check whether SMS fallback is automatic. A local support team also matters once campaigns are live and something needs a same-day fix.
